focus_anchor.role: The focus makes the peoples' dwellings the stated source of visible clarity.

The appearance and clarity scope supports tabayyana as becoming evident.
The settlement scope supplies masakin as dwellings.

The rebellious-agent scope supports Satan as the actor.
The intentional-action scope supplies deeds.
The turning-aside scope supplies their diversion.
The traversed-way scope supplies the ordinary sense of path.
The inward-discernment scope supports mustabsirin as perceptive.

structural_cues.role: The coordinated accusative list names two peoples.

structural_cues.quote_ar: وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
structural_cues.role: The consecutive fa links beautification of deeds with diversion from the path.
The past-state construction presents discernment as a prior condition.

baseline_models.mechanism: Visible communal evidence is juxtaposed with active moral redirection: discernment is present, but beautification leads into diversion.
baseline_models.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus wording and lexical scopes. Treating the fa sequence as causal or consecutive follows the syntax; taking mustabsirin as discernment rather than guidance is an ordinary but limited reading. Dwellings need not mean ruins, and insight need not mean complete knowledge. No additional assumption is needed for the ordinary reading.
baseline_models.containment: Keep this as the ordinary focus reading. It does not specify the exact deeds, the precise path, or the mode of Satanic beautification.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's deeds are not displaced onto the tempter: they become burdens carried by the actors themselves.

focus_anchor.role: The focus identifies the deeds that are made attractive.

activation_trace.role: The intentional-action scope identifies the accountable deeds.
The responsibility-and-sin scope makes the burden morally borne.
The repeated heaviness scope intensifies the burden image.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: deeds are beautified by an external tempter.
Context makes the actors carry their own burdens and additional burdens.

structural_cues.role: Context explicitly locates the wrongdoing in the people themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The window reuses the work-and-burden field: Satan explains attraction, while the actors remain the bearers of the resulting wrong.

changed_reading.before: Their deeds are presented primarily as objects Satan makes attractive.
changed_reading.after: Their deeds are also moral loads carried by them, so Satanic beautification does not erase agency.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The burden and self-wrong wording is packet-supplied. The non-exculpatory implication is a reader inference from its juxtaposition with the focus; the exact scope of the additional burdens remains open.
context_deltas.containment: State that temptation does not transfer responsibility, without importing a fuller doctrine of punishment or assigning every later burden to this verse.

context_deltas.reading: Beautification gains a social channel: false idol practice is tied to shared worldly affection and can be reinforced by communal attachment.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the beautification mechanism.

activation_trace.role: The active-improvement scope supports an operation that makes conduct look good.
The idol scope supplies the concrete false object of worship.
The falsehood scope frames the practice as diverted from truth.
The repeated idol scope confirms a shared practice.
The affection scope locates the practice in a bond between people.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: conduct is made attractive.
Context links worship practice with constructed falsehood.
Context explicitly frames the idols as a worldly bond.
The later reversal exposes the instability of that bond.

context_deltas.mechanism: Idol practice moves from a false act to a shared relation; the relation makes it attractive, while later mutual disavowal exposes the fragility of the beautification.

changed_reading.before: Satanic beautification reads mainly as individual distortion of deeds.
changed_reading.after: It can also describe false practice reinforced by shared affection, conformity, and worldly solidarity.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies idols, falsehood, affection, and later disavowal. The bridge identifying social attachment as one channel of beautification is reader-supplied; personal desire or authority remain live alternatives.
context_deltas.containment: Keep this as an exploratory social activation. Do not claim that all affection is satanic or that the focus gives a complete sociology of idolatry.

context_deltas.reading: The dwellings become retained, observable signs: the focus participates in a window-wide pedagogy of learning from visible traces.

focus_anchor.role: The focus locates clarity in the peoples' dwellings.

activation_trace.role: The settlement scope fixes the focus evidence in dwellings.
The clarity scope supplies the focus's evidentness.
The residual-trace scope activates what is deliberately left behind.

The travel scope places evidence in the landscape.
The directed-looking scope supplies the method of inspection.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: dwellings are a site of clarity.
Context turns travel and observation into a mode of learning.
Context explicitly presents a remaining trace as a clear sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible dwelling and a retained sign are connected by the sequence of leaving traces, traveling, and looking; the focus becomes evidence meant to be inspected.

changed_reading.before: Their dwellings make the historical outcome visibly clear.
changed_reading.after: Their dwellings function as retained signs within a deliberate practice of observing and reasoning from material traces.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies dwellings, remnants, signs, travel, and observation. Applying the remnant-sign pattern specifically to the focus dwellings is a contextual inference; it does not require assuming archaeological ruins.
context_deltas.containment: Describe the dwellings as observable traces or signs, not as a claim about a particular surviving site or archaeological identification.

context_deltas.reading: The final clause becomes a culpable contrast: they had access to clear evidence or recognition, yet perceptiveness did not keep them on the right course.

focus_anchor.role: The focus attributes discernment to the people despite their diversion.

activation_trace.role: The inner-sight scope supplies the focus's discernment.
The clear-sign scope supplies explicit evidence received by another resistant people.
The turning-away scope echoes being diverted after recognition.

structural_cues.role: Context shows recognition or dependence in crisis followed by reversion.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear signs, acknowledgment, and practical perception are repeatedly separated from right orientation; the focus's insight therefore does not guarantee guidance.

changed_reading.before: Mustabsirin denotes a perceptive or discerning condition.
changed_reading.after: It also marks the tragic coexistence of perception or recognition with arrogance, delusion, and misdirection.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clear signs, acknowledgment, turning away, and shirk. The claim that discernment becomes culpably ineffective is inferred from their juxtaposition. Worldly intelligence without complete revelation-awareness remains a live alternative.
context_deltas.containment: Do not infer that the people consciously rejected every truth or that mustabsirin necessarily means complete theological knowledge.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's external clarity can be paired with an internal and textual form of evidence: signs are also carried in learned hearts and in recited scripture.

structural_cues.role: Context presents recited scripture as sufficient evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: External dwelling signs and internal or recited signs form a possible evidence chain: clarity must be received and understood, not merely seen.

changed_reading.before: The focus emphasizes visible clarity from the dwellings.
changed_reading.after: The context permits a broader pairing of outward traces with inwardly carried and verbally recited signs.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet directly supplies signs in dwellings, hearts, and scripture. Treating these as parallel evidence locations is reader-supplied; 29:49–51 may instead concern scripture independently of the focus dwellings.
context_deltas.containment: Present this as an exploratory parallel, not as an assertion that the focus equates physical dwellings with revelation.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's deeds can also be read as experienced consequences: what was beautified is later presented as something to taste.

focus_anchor.role: The focus names the deeds that are beautified.

activation_trace.role: The intentional-action scope supplies the focus deeds.

The repeated action scope explicitly reconnects the outcome to what they did.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: deeds are the object of deceptive attractiveness.
Context turns prior action into an experienced consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated action field is linked to tasting, shifting deeds from attractive causes into results encountered by the actors.

changed_reading.before: Deeds are works Satan makes attractive.
changed_reading.after: Those works can also return as experienced consequences of what they themselves did.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repeated action root and the command to taste are packet-supplied. The consequence relation follows the wording, while tasting may remain idiomatic rather than literal.
context_deltas.containment: Use this as a consequence activation, without claiming that the focus itself specifies the form or timing of punishment.

context_deltas.reading: The focus's path of diversion is counterposed by a path of guidance opened through striving.

focus_anchor.role: The focus presents active diversion from a path.

activation_trace.role: The turning-away scope supplies the negative direction.
The focus path scope supplies the route image.
The effort scope supplies the human counter-response.
The guidance scope supplies the opposed divine direction.
The repeated path scope makes the directional reversal visible.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: Satanic action diverts people from the path.
Context pairs striving with guidance to God's paths.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same path image reverses agency: Satan turns people away, while striving is met with divine guidance.

changed_reading.before: The path appears chiefly as the route from which the people were diverted.
changed_reading.after: The focus participates in a reversible directional model in which striving and guidance provide a counter-route.

context_deltas.reader_inference: The repeated path root and the opposed verbs are packet-supplied. Reading singular al-sabil and plural subul as a deliberate reversal is an inference; the plural need not imply multiple doctrinal paths.
context_deltas.containment: Describe this as a directional contrast, not as a definitive mapping of every possible path or guidance route.

surprising_valid_outliers.reading: As an exploratory material analogy, Satanically beautified works can function like an apparent shelter or alliance whose protective appearance is structurally weak.

focus_anchor.role: The focus supplies the beautified works to which the material analogy returns.

activation_trace.role: The active-beautification scope supplies the appearance of value or protection.
The dwelling scope keeps the focus connected to shelter imagery.
The alliance-and-support scope supplies the apparent protective patron.
The spider scope supplies the flimsy web-producing creature.
The shelter scope supplies the house image.
The weakness scope explicitly evaluates the apparent shelter.

structural_cues.role: Focus end: works acquire deceptive attractiveness.
Context supplies a material image of apparent shelter exposed as weak.

surprising_valid_outliers.mechanism: The spider-house analogy reframes beautification as false security: an apparent refuge or alliance can look protective while failing under pressure.

changed_reading.before: Beautification concerns the attractiveness of the people's deeds.
changed_reading.after: The deeds can be explored as a constructed shelter-like system whose attractive appearance masks weakness.

surprising_valid_outliers.reader_inference: The packet supplies the focus's beautification and dwelling language and the context's alliance, house, spider, and weakness images. Mapping the spider house onto the focus's deeds is reader-supplied; the parable may be limited to false allies or idols.
surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from moral action into material architecture. Present it only as an analogy, never as the literal lexical meaning of the focus or as a claim that every beautified deed is fragile.

summary.ordinary_reading: Ordinarily, 29:38 says that the dwellings of ʿĀd and Thamūd make their fate clear: Satan beautified their deliberate deeds and turned them from the path, although they had discernment.
coexisting_readings: The dwellings can function as retained, observable signs within the window's pedagogy of travel, seeing, and reasoning from traces.
Discernment can coexist with misorientation: clear evidence or recognition does not itself guarantee guidance, and the actors still bear the burdens and consequences of their deeds.
The focus can be socially activated through shared idol practice and worldly attachment, while striving and divine guidance provide a counter-direction.
An exploratory parallel pairs external dwelling signs with signs carried in learned hearts and recited scripture; the spider-house reading remains a bounded analogy of false shelter.
unresolved_limits: The window has an annotation gap at 29:1 and no branch inventories for ك ي ف, ع ث و, or خ ط ط; these limit window-wide lexical tracing but do not undercut the available focus evidence.
The focus does not specify the exact deeds, the content of the path, or the mode of Satanic beautification; dwellings should not be identified as archaeological ruins without further evidence.
مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ may remain perceptive or insightful without implying complete revelation-awareness. The social, internal-sign, and spider-house activations require qualification.
